items.defectStatement: The auth.anonymous section in conf/defaults.ini lacks device_limit. Environment overrides run before readAuthSettings and only visit existing keys, so GF_AUTH_ANONYMOUS_DEVICE_LIMIT alone is ignored and the limit remains zero, disabling enforcement.
obligations: Register an uncommented device_limit setting under auth.anonymous in the default configuration.
Ensure GF_AUTH_ANONYMOUS_DEVICE_LIMIT works without a custom INI entry.
Keep the default limit at zero and preserve normal configuration override precedence.
items.notes: The cited assignment correctly reads the parsed setting; the missing entry belongs in conf/defaults.ini, outside the supplied code. A late dynamic environment read can change command-line precedence and bypass configuration expansion.
